text: じゅうでん　して　どうろで　つかってね！

structure.jp: どうろで　つかってね！
structure.en: use it on the routes, okay?

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て joins it to the next action: first this, then that. じゅうでんして = 'charge it and then'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て at the end of a sentence is a friendly way to ask someone to do something, and ね makes it softer. つかってね = 'use it, okay?'.
